name: GC Minimal Zine Poster
title: GC Minimal Zine Poster — AI Editorial Poster Skill
description: Explore GC Minimal Zine Poster: paper-texture posters, reference analysis, photo input and prompt-only workflows, with author examples and source-pinned setup guidance.

summary.en: GC Minimal Zine Poster turns a theme, short text or supplied photograph into a sparse editorial poster. Its source specifies a default 3:5 page, generous negative space, a small focal element, restrained typography and one vivid color accent. It is an image-design skill, not a tool for generating website UI or frontend code.
summary.zh: GC Minimal Zine Poster 将主题、短文或用户照片转化为留白充足的编辑式海报。源码规定默认使用 3:5 画布、小面积视觉焦点、克制字体与一个鲜明的点缀色。它属于图像设计技能，不是生成网页 UI 或前端代码的工具。

workflow.en: Choose Generate for a poster, Prompt-only for an image prompt, or Reference Analysis to extract a visual system. Photo Input asks the agent to distinguish an edit target from a style reference and record what must be preserved. Generation needs a compatible image-capable agent; provider usage charges may apply. The skill itself declares no separate API key requirement.
workflow.zh: 需要海报时选择 Generate，只要生图提示词时选择 Prompt-only，提取视觉规则时选择 Reference Analysis。Photo Input 会区分编辑目标与风格参考，并记录必须保留的主体特征。生成图片需要具备图像能力的兼容 Agent，可能产生服务用量费用；该技能本身未要求单独提供 API 密钥。

limitations.en: Best suited to quiet zine pages, editorial illustrations and poetic visual studies. It deliberately avoids glossy commercial layouts, dense collages and 3D rendering. The Gallery shows three author-published examples, not outputs executed or verified by OpenAgentSkill. Exact typography, photo preservation and model compatibility still need a small test in your own environment.
limitations.zh: 适合安静的杂志页面、编辑插图和诗意视觉练习；不适合高光商业广告、密集拼贴或 3D 渲染。Gallery 展示的是作者公开的三张案例，不是 OpenAgentSkill 执行或验证的成果。文字准确度、照片主体保真与模型兼容性仍需在自己的环境中小范围测试。

name: Native Subtitle Quote Image
title: Native Subtitle Quote Image — Video to Quote Card Skill
description: Create speech and interview quote cards from real video frames. Explore our JFK speech example, checked transcript, source credits and reproducible local render.

galleryLabel.en: Explore the JFK speech quote-card example
galleryLabel.zh: 查看肯尼迪演讲金句长图案例

summary.en: Native Subtitle Quote Image turns speech, interview and film excerpts into social quote cards using real video frames. Native mode preserves captions already burned into a video; script mode draws checked text onto real frames and labels it as added subtitles. Our worked example uses the latter: six English lines from John F. Kennedy’s 1962 Rice University speech become a 1080 × 1440 quote card, with archival footage and official transcript sources supplied.
summary.zh: Native Subtitle Quote Image 使用真实视频画面，将演讲、访谈和电影片段制作成社交金句长图。原生模式保留视频中已有的烧录字幕；脚本模式把已核对台词绘制到真实画面，并明确标为后期字幕。本站案例采用脚本模式：选取肯尼迪 1962 年莱斯大学演讲的六行英文原话，制作一张 1080×1440 金句长图，附档案影像与官方文字稿来源。

workflow.en: Choose a video you may process and publish, verify the speaker and quotation, and select stable frames at the relevant timestamps. If text remains visible with player captions switched off, use native mode. Otherwise, review a timestamped script and use script mode. Our example provides a 28-second NASA archival excerpt, checked English lines, source and timing references, exact command and actual run record. Open the result to check the speaker, line order and text boundaries. Local rendering needs Python, Pillow, FFmpeg and a suitable font for script text.
workflow.zh: 先选取有权处理和发布的视频，核对演讲者和引语，再按相关时间点挑选稳定画面。关闭播放器字幕后文字仍在画面里，可用原生模式；否则核对带时间点的台词脚本，使用脚本模式。本站案例提供 28 秒 NASA 档案片段、已核对英文原话、影像与时间点来源、准确命令和实际运行记录。打开成品检查人物、句子顺序和文字边界。本地渲染需要 Python、Pillow、FFmpeg，脚本字幕另需合适字体。

limitations.en: This example uses the cataloged v2.1.1 source at f9485e20; newer upstream revisions are not covered. JFK’s footage has no burned-in captions, so the text in our output is post-production script subtitles. Archival frames retain their original limitations; cropping and enlarging them does not restore detail. One local English script render was exercised, not installation, native mode, translation, cross-agent compatibility or security certification. Source footage is credited separately from our selection and rendering. The existing review score and installation policy are unchanged.
limitations.zh: 本案例使用目录已收录的 v2.1.1 固定源码 f9485e20，未覆盖上游新版本。肯尼迪的源影像没有烧录字幕，成品文字由脚本模式后期绘制。档案画面的清晰度受源素材限制，裁切和放大不能恢复细节。本次测试覆盖一次本地英文脚本渲染，未测试安装、原生模式、翻译、跨 Agent 兼容性或安全认证。影像来源与本站选句、渲染贡献分别署名；原审核评分与安装策略保留。
